# Revelation Media Resources

> All Things New: a Daniel and Revelation prophecy seminar series kit for church leaders. Nine presentations with images, videos and promo materials, editable in PowerPoint, Keynote and Google Slides.

Revelation Media Resources is a library of ready-made materials for running an evangelistic prophecy series: presentations, slides, images, videos, and promotional materials for pastors, church leaders, and ministry organizations.

## Key facts

- Audience: Pastors, church leaders and ministry organizations
- Price: no cost, no registration
- Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/), credit: Ministerial Association, General Conference of Seventh-day Adventists
- Formats: PowerPoint, Keynote, Google Slides
- What is included: 9 presentations, ~450 slides, ~400 images, 10 videos, 20 marketing assets
- Program stages: Promote and invite; Lead the meetings; Enrich with media; Hand out; Celebrate
- Site languages: English (https://kazizova-omb.github.io/evangelism-library-landing/), Español (https://kazizova-omb.github.io/evangelism-library-landing/es)

## Daniel & Revelation Bible Prophecy Seminar

Nine evenings in the books of Daniel and Revelation, read in plain language from the Bible itself. We will see that God told history in advance, that He has a plan to end evil, suffering, and death, and that Jesus is coming to make all things new. Every evening asks what that hope means for your life now. Downloads: https://kazizova-omb.github.io/evangelism-library-landing/#series
- 01 History Written in Advance (Daniel 2): A king's forgotten dream told the rise and fall of the world's empires centuries before they happened, and history has followed it line by line. If God knew the end from the beginning, He can be trusted with your tomorrow.
- 02 The War Behind the World (The Great Controversy): Why is there so much pain in a world made by a God of love? The Bible traces evil to its beginning, shows how the cross settled the war, and promises that evil's days are numbered.
- 03 The Longest Prophecy and Our High Priest (Daniel 8–9 and the Sanctuary): The longest time prophecy in the Bible named the year the Messiah would come, and He came on time. The same prophecy shows what Jesus is doing for us right now in heaven, as the High Priest who forgives the moment we come to Him.
- 04 The Sign He Never Changed (The Sabbath): From Eden to the new earth, the seventh day is the Creator's sign of rest and belonging, kept by Jesus and never changed by God. It is a weekly gift, a day to stop and rest in what Christ has finished.
- 05 The Final Choice (Daniel 7 and Revelation 13–14): Daniel 7 and Revelation 13 describe the last conflict of history, and it is about worship. God tells the story in advance so that no one is deceived, and so that everyone can choose Him freely.
- 06 Heaven's Last Message (The Three Angels): Before Jesus returns, God sends one last message to every nation, tribe, tongue, and people. It is the everlasting gospel, a call to worship the Creator, and a loving appeal to come out of confusion and into His arms.
- 07 The Church God Is Looking For (The Four Horsemen and the Remnant): Through persecution and compromise, God has always had a people. Revelation shows how to recognize them in the last days and invites you to find a home among them.
- 08 The End of Evil (Hell): God will not torment anyone forever. The Bible shows how He will end sin, Satan, suffering, and death completely, and then make everything new, so that you can face the future without fear.
- 09 All Things New: Hope Starts Here (The Second Coming and the New Earth): Jesus is coming again, in person, and every eye will see Him. The dead in Christ will rise, the signs are labor pains with an end and a purpose, and a new earth is waiting where God Himself will wipe away every tear. Hope starts here, and it ends in His presence.

## FAQ

### What is Revelation Media Resources?

Revelation Media Resources is a library of ready-made materials for running an evangelistic prophecy series: presentations, slides, images, videos, and promotional materials for pastors, church leaders, and ministry organizations.

### Do I need to pay or register?

No. There is no cost and no registration: everything downloads directly. The original resources are licensed under CC BY‑NC 4.0, so you may use, adapt, translate, and share them for your ministry, as long as you give credit and do not use them commercially.

### Who can use these materials?

Pastors, church leaders, and ministry organizations who want to run an evangelistic series. No design skills are needed: the files are ready to present and easy to adapt to your church.

### What formats are included?

Presentations come in PowerPoint, Keynote, and Google Slides. Images and videos are provided in standard formats that work on any device.

### Can I edit the materials?

Yes. You can change text, reorder slides, and add your church's details to fit your program.

### Which languages are available?

The kit is available in English today. More languages are coming soon and will be added progressively; see the list in the translation section below. Fluent in another language? You can help us translate it.
